maya: Quick heads-up — opened a docs PR to update EU endpoint examples and add a clearer data-residency note for Private/Dedicated deployments. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 (please review wording + SDK snippets). tagging @alejandra @ian @chris for a quick pass :wave:
alejandra: Thanks — on it. I'll check the EU availability table and make sure the footnote about 'stored in-region' is consistent with the legal copy. Also will hunt down the broken compliance link chris mentioned earlier.
ian: I can handle SDK snippet migration (py -> ts/js). Do we want to standardize on fetch + async/await for JS samples? Current py examples use requests + simple param 'region'. Should we add an explicit 'region' option in all examples?
chris: Yes to region param — makes it explicit. The broken link in the PR points to /compliance/eu which 404s. The correct page is /compliance/eu-residency (I think). I'll post the exact URL after I confirm with legal. :mag:
maya: Good call. Also please add a tiny Dedicated example showing how to pin model to eu-west-1 in code samples (one-liner). Customers keep asking for that.
ian: Draft JS snippet (will polish after feedback):
```js
// TypeScript/Fetch example - pin to eu-west-1
const resp = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_API_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-neo-3', input: 'summarize this', region: 'eu-west-1' })
});
const data = await resp.json();
console.log(data.output);
```
ian: Python snippet to mirror (requests):
```py
# Python requests example - Dedicated region pin
import os, requests
resp = requests.post(
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate',
  headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['RW_API_KEY']}"},
  json={'model': 'gpt-neo-3', 'input': 'summarize this', 'region': 'eu-west-1'}
)
print(resp.json()['output'])
```
alejandra: Snippets look good. A few copy edits for the data residency paragraph: change "may be stored" to "are stored" for Dedicated/Private, and add a parenthetical note about encryption at rest + KMS usage. Also let's link to the compliance page using the canonical slug we confirm with legal.
chris: Confirmed — legal wants us to link to /compliance/data-residency/eu and use the short footnote: "EU residency available for Dedicated and Private deployments; contact sales for on-prem options."
maya: Awesome. Can someone replace the old /compliance/eu link in the PR and add a 1-line note under "Region availability" about model pinning? After that I'll run the docs CI and merge if green. :white_check_mark:
docs-bot: Link-checker report: 1 broken internal link found -> /compliance/eu (PR #512). Suggest replacement: /compliance/data-residency/eu.
ian: Done — updated the JS + Python snippets to include 'region' param and swapped the link. Pushed a small commit to the PR.
alejandra: Updated the data residency paragraph and added the encryption/KMS parenthetical. Also shortened the footnote copy to match legal's guidance.
maya: Thanks all — running ci now. If green I'll merge this afternoon. :rocket:
chris: LGTM after small edits, thanks everyone.
docs-bot: CI status: pending (docs-ci).
maya: CI passed, merging. :sparkles:
